title: The postcard addressed to a crossed street
body: The postcard is stamped and addressed, but the map beneath it ends at a street crossed out in pencil. The message stops after, “We were told to wait by—”.
rival_reading: A field delivery could be delayed by a road restriction and leave an unfinished message; the card does not say who issued the instruction.
gloss: A message and its map both stop short of a destination.

title: The garden column with no matching season
body: A newspaper gardening column is folded around a notebook sketch of three crop rows. The drawing has a water line but no planting date; the column is for winter.
rival_reading: Someone tracking seasonal conditions during an emergency could keep an old gardening column with field notes; the mismatch does not identify an experimental program.
gloss: A crop sketch and an out-of-season guide sit together.
